name: Environmelisma, de Lorenzo Sandoval e Pedro André + Milene, de Francisco Fonseca Cândido + O Leite das Monarcas, de Francisco Nuno Rodrigues + Eu não sei sobre muita coisa, de Rebecca Moreno
description: A film screening featuring four works presented as part of Porto/Post/Doc's Competição Cinema Novo section at Passos Manuel.
longDescription:
This film screening gathers four works for the Competição Cinema Novo section of Porto/Post/Doc: Film & Media Festival. The program includes Environmelisma by Lorenzo Sandoval and Pedro André, Milene by Francisco Fonseca Cândido, O Leite das Monarcas by Francisco Nuno Rodrigues, and Eu não sei sobre muita coisa by Rebecca Moreno.

The session takes place on 22 November 2026 at 17:00 at Passos Manuel, located at Rua de Passos Manuel, 137. Tickets cost 5 euros, with discounts available for Cartão Porto holders. The event is rated for ages 12 and up and is not accessible for people with reduced mobility.
